As a Technical Anchor, you will oversee the technical design, development, and delivery of business-critical applications and high-throughput data platforms. You will establish engineering excellence across full-stack systems, architect resilient Java-based microservices, deliver responsive front-end data exploration interfaces using React or Angular, and design enterprise-grade cloud data streaming and analytical pipelines on GCP. You will lead distributed engineering squads across local and global locations, driving cloud modernization, data governance, and operational reliability to fuel Ford’s digital transformation.

### **1. Technical Leadership, Architecture & Modernization**

* **Anchor Technical Delivery:** Act as the primary technical anchor, translating complex business requirements from legacy applications in GDIA into scalable, fault-tolerant system designs, architectural blueprints, and execution roadmaps.
* **Architecture Standards:** Drive the evolution of Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA), cloud-native microservices, and event-driven patterns. Establish coding standards, API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger), and architectural governance across squads.
* **Legacy System Modernization:** Lead legacy modernization initiatives by re-architecting monolithic services into modular, containerized workloads on GCP, engineering continuous ingestion flows from heterogeneous enterprise platforms.
* **Engineering Mentorship & SDLC Excellence:** Champion agile engineering best practices, enforce test-driven development (TDD), lead comprehensive code reviews, and mentor engineers across full-stack, data engineering, and cloud domains.

### **2. Full-Stack & Microservices Engineering**

* **Backend Services:** Architect and develop robust, high-performance microservices and RESTful APIs using Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and supporting synchronous transactions and asynchronous event-driven flows.
* **Frontend & Data Visualization:** Build responsive, user-centric interfaces using Angular, React, and Node.js that integrate seamlessly with backend APIs to deliver intuitive self-service data access, reporting, and interactive data visualization.
* **API Gateway & Service Mesh:** Design and standardize API gateway topologies using Apigee; enforce service discovery, circuit breakers, rate limiting, and resilient inter-service communication.
* **Performance Engineering & Optimization:** Profile and optimize distributed systems end-to-end, including JVM tuning, connection pooling, caching strategies, and database query tuning across relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL datastores.

### **3. Cloud Data Engineering & Analytics**

* **Scalable Data Pipelines:** Architect, build, and maintain real-time streaming and high-volume batch data pipelines leveraging GCP Dataflow (Apache Beam), Dataproc (Spark/Hadoop), and Cloud Pub/Sub.
* **Modern Data Warehousing:** Standardize, model, partition, and optimize enterprise datasets within Google BigQuery to ensure exceptional SQL query performance, cost efficiency, and real-time analytical capabilities.

### **4. Security, Governance & Compliance**

* **Zero Trust Security:** Enforce least-privileged access control across applications, integrating Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), ADFS, OAuth2/OIDC, and method-level access authorization.
* **Cloud & Data Governance:** Implement robust cloud security frameworks, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), data encryption (in transit and at rest), data masking, and GCP-native row-level and column-level security.
* **Regulatory Compliance:** Partner with cybersecurity, compliance, and governance teams to maintain adherence to enterprise data privacy mandates and corporate security standards.

### **5. DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure & Observability**

* **Infrastructure as Code (IaC):** Automate and manage repeatable cloud infrastructure and platform provisioning using Terraform.
* **CI/CD Automation:** Design and optimize enterprise CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Tekton, and build automation tools (Maven, Gradle) for automated testing, static code analysis, and zero-downtime deployments.
* **Operational Reliability & Telemetry:** Establish proactive monitoring, tracing, and alerting frameworks across Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Cloud Run, and Cloud Functions to diagnose distributed system bottlenecks and ensure platform health.
* **AI/ML Innovation:** Apply foundational AI and Machine Learning (ML) concepts, including Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), to accelerate engineering workflows and enhance software capabilities.

* **Backend Engineering:** Deep expertise in **Java (Java 17+)**, **Spring Ecosystem** (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Spring Security), and scripting proficiency.
* **Frontend Engineering:** Hands-on experience developing data visualization and exploration interfaces using **React**, **Angular**, or **Node.js**.
* **GCP Cloud Platforms:** Proven track record architecting and deploying systems on **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**, specifically **BigQuery**, **Cloud Run**, **GKE** and **Cloud Pub/Sub**.

Job Summary  
Experience Required: 6–9+ Years  
  
Job Summary  
We are seeking a high caliber Senior AS/400 (IBM i) Systems Administrator / Infrastructure Engineer (L3 Support) to serve as the senior technical authority for our enterprise IBM Power Systems platform. In this lead engineering role, you will be responsible for platform architecture, operating system upgrades, virtualization design, deep tier incident forensics, high availability/disaster recovery (HA/DR) design, storage engineering, and performance optimization.  
The successful candidate will act as the final internal escalation tier for mission critical IBM i infrastructure incidents, drive complex OS migrations across releases (IBM i 7.3, 7.4, and 7.5), architect PowerVM and VIOS environments, optimize enterprise storage configurations (IASP, SAN integration), and orchestrate automated HA/DR replication architectures (PowerHA, MIMIX). This role focuses purely on system architecture, operating system engineering, security hardening, and infrastructure resilience, serving as the technical liaison to IBM Support (PMR/Escalations), enterprise architects, and executive IT management.  
  
  
Key Responsibilities  
1. Level 3 Escalation, Deep Diagnostics & Root Cause Analysis (RCA)  
  
. Serve as the supreme technical escalation authority for severe (P1/Major) system outages, abnormal IPLs, kernel exceptions, hung partitions, and machine check conditions.  
. Conduct advanced system crash investigations using System Service Tools (SST), Dedicated Service Tools (DST), Main Storage Dumps (MSD), and LIC trace analysis.  
. Interrogate advanced logs (PAL, QHST, Advanced Job Logs) to diagnose complex intermittent hardware faults, bus channel errors, and memory corruptions.  
. Own and author definitive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation; engineer preventative architecture changes to permanently eliminate systemic failure modes.  
. Manage and drive complex technical support cases (PMRs / IBM Support Cases), coordinating directly with IBM Level 3 labs and Rochester development teams.  
  
2. Operating System Lifecycle, Version Migrations & PTF Engineering  
  
. Architect, plan, and execute major OS release upgrades (e.g., migrations from IBM i 7.3/7.4 to 7.5) and Technology Refresh (TR) cycles across large scale enterprise estates.  
. Formulate comprehensive PTF management policies; perform cross subsystem prerequisite/corequisite analysis, microcode/firmware compatibility matrices, and regression risk assessments.  
. Manage system level configurations including dynamic tuning system values, Workload Groups, Subsystem Descriptions (SBSD), Class parameters, and memory pool allocations.  
. Oversee system initialization scripts, startup programs (QSTRUP), subsystem routing architectures, and operational configurations.  
  
3. Power Systems Architecture, PowerVM & VIOS Engineering  
  
. Architect, configure, and maintain enterprise IBM Power Systems hardware (Power9, Power10) managed via redundant Hardware Management Consoles (HMC).  
. Design and implement PowerVM virtualization solutions, including Virtual I/O Server (VIOS) clustering, Shared Ethernet Adapter (SEA) failover, and N\_Port ID Virtualization (NPIV) SAN mapping.  
. Engineer enterprise LPAR topology, configuring shared processor pools, capped/uncapped partitions, Virtual Processors, and dynamic processor/memory optimization.  
. Lead HMC firmware lifecycles, service processor firmware upgrades, and disaster recovery replication for HMC configurations.  
  
4. Enterprise HA/DR Architecture & Disaster Recovery Orchestration  
  
. Design, implement, and fine tune enterprise High Availability (HA) replication architectures using solutions such as Precisely MIMIX, IBM PowerHA SystemMirror, or Maxava HA.  
. Architect journal environments: Remote Journaling (RJ), asynchronous/synchronous network transport, dual journal receivers, and threshold management.  
. Architect and lead scheduled enterprise Disaster Recovery (DR) and full role swap (switchover / failover) tests, guaranteeing stringent Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).  
. Develop and maintain automated failover scripts, audit validation procedures, and emergency split brain recovery playbooks.  
  
5. Storage Engineering, IASP & Resiliency Architecture  
  
. Architect auxiliary storage topologies, balancing internal NVMe/SAS drives and external SAN arrays (IBM FlashSystem, DS8000) using San Volume Controller (SVC).  
. Implement and manage Independent Auxiliary Storage Pools (IASP) to isolate databases for modular switchover and flash copy operations.  
. Formulate enterprise wide BRMS (Backup, Recovery, and Media Services) architecture, including network synced BRMS clusters, media lifecycle policies, and VTL encryption.  
. Author and validate bare metal disaster recovery procedures, cold start installation plans, and full scale recovery runs (SAVSYS / Option 21 rebuilds).  
  
6. Advanced Performance Tuning, Profiling & Capacity Planning  
  
. Conduct deep tier system performance profiling utilizing IBM i Performance Data Investigator (PDI), Collection Services, Job Watcher, Disk Watcher, and IBM i Doctor.  
. Optimize system memory allocation by tuning dynamic system values (QPFRADJ), defining private memory pools, and resolving object lock contention.  
. Analyze disk subsystem bottlenecks, arm contention, queue depths, and optimize paging space allocation.  
. Formulate multi year capacity planning models predicting CPU (CPW), memory, and SAN storage expansion aligned with corporate business growth.  
  
7. Security Hardening, Audit Forensics & Compliance Architecture  
  
. Architect and enforce OS security hardening in accordance with IBM i Security Level 40 and 50 standards.  
. Establish comprehensive security auditing architectures via QAUDJRN, configuring journal filters for security critical actions and unauthorized object manipulation.  
. Implement adopted authority controls, secure system values (QSECURITY, QPWD\*, QALWUSRDMN), and service program access controls.  
. Drive compliance and vulnerability management programs (SOX, PCI DSS, ISO 27001), designing automated scripts to remediate non compliant configurations.  
  
8. Infrastructure Automation, Modernization & Technical Mentorship  
  
. Architect reusable operational automation utilizing advanced Control Language (CL) programs and modern Db2 for i / IBM i Services (QSYS2).  
. Evaluate and implement modern administration frameworks, such as IBM i open source integration (PASE, Bash, Python), Ansible for IBM i automation, and REST APIs.  
. Serve as the technical mentor and escalation lead for L1 and L2 system administrators, conducting peer technical reviews and establishing enterprise engineering standards.  
. Participate in architectural review boards (ARB) for major business applications and enterprise infrastructure projects.

Required Qualifications

* Own a blended workforce model: manage specialized consultants and a contracting team, with a contract-to-hire approach as the default and direct hiring for key roles where warranted.
* Recruit, onboard, and develop engineers; set the technical bar and team culture from day one. Own integration engineering delivery
* Take ownership of the ServiceNow workstream already underway, including a candid retrospective on what hasn't worked so far.
* Stand up the engineering model for the Pax8/ConnectWise marketplace/PSA integration pilot, in partnership with specialized consultants and the core platform team.
* Build this into a repeatable capability as the integration portfolio grows beyond these two initiatives. Define the operating model with core platform engineering
* Partner directly with the core platform engineering leadership to define architecture and integration patterns, required APIs/workflows, source-code access boundaries, development standards, and the technical point-of-contact model between teams.
* Push for a model where the core platform team focuses on the platform and exposes clean APIs/capabilities, while your team builds and owns integrations on top not one where core teams build every integration themselves. Lead as an AI-native engineering manager
* Use AI tools yourself, day to day for design exploration, code review, testing, documentation, and even parts of people/project management and set that as the visible norm for the team, not an optional add-on.
* Build documentation, API contracts, and integration patterns that are discoverable and usable by AI agents, not just humans.
* Create an engineering environment where AI increasingly assists with implementation, testing, validation, documentation, and knowledge transfer this is a core operating principle for the org from day one, not a future aspiration.
* Actively evaluate and introduce new AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows as they emerge, rather than waiting for direction from above. Operate as a proactive, senior engineering leader
* Work through ambiguity: propose structure, process, and scope rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.
* Partner closely with Product for visibility and alignment, while keeping engineering ownership and decision-making inside engineering.
* Provide regular updates, risks, and recommendations to senior (US-based) engineering leadership, including workforce and contract-to-hire decisions.
* Maintain meaningful overlap with US working hours for real-time collaboration with distributed stakeholders, architects, and product partners.
* Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs.

* This is a full-time and in-office position, reporting to our Chennai office 5 days a week.
* This individual may manage a team and will be reporting directly to our General Manager, Chennai Center of Excellence.
* The targeted compensation package for this role is between INR 55,00,000 LPA and INR 75,00,000 LPA. We may make further adjustments through an approval process if the targeted compensation range needs to be modified based on business needs and market trends.

* Minimum 8+ years in software, systems, or integration engineering, including experience directly managing engineers (as an EM, or as a senior/staff engineer with clear, demonstrable people leadership experience) is required.
* Track record of building or scaling a team from the ground up ideally in a GCC, global captive, or new-site environment, not just growing an existing, well-defined team.
* Hands-on design and administration of API/integration platforms ServiceNow, MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, Azure Integration Services, or comparable including workflow, connector, and access design is required.
* Familiarity with the PSA (Professional Services Automation) ecosystem tools like ConnectWise, Autotask, Kaseya, or similar and how MSPs/partners consume vendor integrations through them.
* Integration design fundamentals: API contract design, data mapping and transformation, authentication patterns, and designing clean ownership boundaries and handoffs between systems and teams.
* AI-native, hands-on daily, practical use of AI tools in your own workflow (AI coding assistants, agentic dev tools, AI for documentation/testing), with the disposition to keep learning as the tooling changes, in line with our AI-DLC direction.
* ITSM/ticketing and collaboration tooling ServiceNow (or an equivalent ITSM tool) and the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence) for engineering workflow, tracking, and documentation.

title: Principal AI Engineer
description:
TechGrove is the **Centre of Excellence** for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan's global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India's deep pool of technical talent with Banyan's long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work.

**About Berkeley Myles**  
We build software for UK manufacturers who can't afford to get things wrong: aerospace, medical devices, oil and gas, motorsport. Our product, ProgressPlus, runs the whole job from first enquiry through to final invoice. Hundreds of manufacturers run on it every day, and when one of them has to prove what went into a part, it's where the answer comes from. We're now building a new product with AI on every stage of that flow.  
We're part of Banyan Software, the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialised industries, their employees, and their customers. Banyan is a Great Place to Work Certified company, a five-time Inc. 5000 honoree, and a top-10 company on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500.  
Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Atlanta, Banyan operates more than 100 portfolio companies across North America, the UK, the EU, and APAC.

**About the Role**  
A manufacturer runs one flow: enquiry, quote, order, jobs, scheduling, tracking, quality, shipping, invoice. ProgressPlus is the system of record for that flow. We're building the system of action on top of  
it: AI that works on every stage, capturing enquiries, validating orders, optimising schedules, anticipating problems, and reconciling invoices, always with a human in control and every step  
auditable. You'll be the company's first AI engineer. There's not much AI in production today: no agents, no runtime, no AI layer. You'll build the system of action from a blank page. It has two parts: the events that announce what just happened in the business, and the agents that act on them. Agents that plan multi- step work, run in the background, act under their own identity with bounded authority, and leave a trail a regulated manufacturer can show an auditor. The ground is prepared. Five .NET services with architecture boundaries enforced in CI, and a growing catalog of transaction-safe business operations ready to become AI tools. This is a founding role: you set the architecture, the standards and the evaluation discipline that every AI feature in this product gets built on.

**Key Responsibilities**  
Build the agentic layer: one coherent layer that every AI capability in the product runs on. Once it exists, adding AI to any stage of the manufacturing flow is a few weeks of feature work.  
The runtime and the tools Architect the agent runtime: a server-side loop with durable runs, retries, scheduled and event-driven triggers, and human-in-the-loop steps  
Build the tool layer that turns our catalog of transaction-safe business operations into typed, tenant- scoped, permissioned AI tools, for our own agents and for the outside world through MCP  
Evaluation and audit Make evals part of how we ship: fixture-based tests of every AI behaviour, wired into CI from day one Close the correction loop: every override, rejection and edit captured as structured signal, so evals and retrieval improve from real use Build agent auditing into the platform's tamper-evident action log as it lands: every agent step logged, attributable and replayable. Our customers pass AS9100 audits, and explainable AI is a  
feature we sell Grounding and operations Drive the event catalog: which business facts the product announces, from the office to the shop floor (SalesOrderCreated, GoodsReceived, JobRunningLate). Every agent run starts from one Grow the semantic grounding: a machine-readable model of the business and how it fits together, so agents retrieve facts instead of inventing them  
Own the agent authority model: what an agent may do, its budget, how much autonomy each workflow gets. Instrument the runtime so every step is metered and traced  
Run what you ship: your agents in production are yours, including the incident when one misbehaves

What Success Looks Like  
First three months: one real workflow runs end to end on the agent runtime in production, with its evals in CI and every step in the audit log.  
First six months: more agents are live on the same layer, and at least one of them was built by one of the full stack engineers.  
First twelve months: adding AI to a stage of the flow is a few weeks of feature work for any engineer here, and you can show an auditor how any of it reached the answer it did.

How We Work  
Linear as the single board: work traced from issue to acceptance criteria to PR, reporting as a by- product of the work  
A small team: full stack engineers with a lead, plus AI and platform specialists, on a .NET and Next.js platform on Azure Prototype-led: we design the flow before we build it, against a shared design system  
AI in daily use across the team: coding agents in the repo with the context they need, and AI tooling  
for research, prototyping and analysis  
A customer base we can pick up the phone to, and an implementation team on their sites every week

**Tech Stack You'll Use**  
Backend: C#, .NET 10, Rebus messaging, SQL Server (database per company)  
Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript  
Cloud: Azure (Container Apps, Azure SQL, Service Bus, Front Door), Bicep, GitHub Actions  
AI: Model-agnostic by design, with MCP as the tool protocol  
Tooling: Claude Code, Linear, GitHub

**What We're Looking For**
  
You've taken multiple LLM-powered systems from prototype to production, at least one of them agentic (multi-step, tool-using, running unattended), and you can walk us through what broke and  
what you'd redo Product instincts and a builder's disposition: you can sit with a planner or a quoting manager, translate their workflow into an agent architecture without being handed a spec, then write the code,  
ship it, and talk to the people who use it Strong backend and systems engineering experience (5+ years). You've built event-driven systems,  
you can explain why the transactional outbox exists, and you think in contracts, idempotency and failure modes  
You treat evals and observability as part of the definition of done, and you've wired LLM evaluation and observability tooling  
You treat AI security as an engineering problem: injection containment, retrieved content handled strictly as data, and hostile inputs in the eval suite  
Clear opinions on build versus buy: you know which parts of an agent stack to take from providers and which parts you have to own  
Comfortable being first: setting standards, writing them down, and reviewing others' work against them  
Strong written communication: you'll work with a team split across time zones  
Preferred Experience  
You've shipped something in manufacturing, ERP, supply chain or industrial operations, or you're genuinely curious about how factories run  
Document extraction pipelines: structured extraction from PDFs and email, OCR cascades, confidence-scored human review

Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws.
